positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-proximity-assignment
positions.summary: On Oct. 13, 2026, Kim voted for Option C, which replaces the lottery with assignment to a neighborhood school based on home address, and said the board should be proud to move to a neighborhood model.

citations.quote: SFUSD Board President Phil Kim voted for a plan that will enroll students in neighborhood schools and replace the unpopular lottery.
Board President Phil Kim said the board “should be proud of the fact today that we are moving forward to a neighborhood model.”
He says if the district is going to place students at a neighborhood school, officials need to be able to guarantee certain resources.
